title: VoiceFlow word-list profile, one layer (voiceflow-profile v2)
description: One layer of a user's word lists, version 2: everything in version 1, plus the shared style fields and pinned styles marked (v2). A file that uses a (v2) field must say schemaVersion 2; a reader that knows only version 1 refuses it whole and keeps its last good copy, so nothing may write version 2 until every device of the user reads it (pack/README.md, Versions). VoiceFlow merges the layers by precedence: built-in defaults < household < generated < personal < edits made in the app. A file is accepted whole or not at all; a rejected file leaves the last good copy in use. See pack/README.md.

schemaVersion.description: 2 when the file uses a (v2) field, else 1. A version 1 file with a (v2) field is refused. A client refuses a version it does not know and keeps its last good copy.

layer.description: Must match where the file sits: profiles/household/profile.json is household, profiles/<user>/generated/profile.json is generated, profiles/<user>/profile.json is personal.

user.description: "household" for the household layer, else the user the file belongs to (the folder name).

updatedBy.description: Who or what wrote it last (a person, an assistant, a generator).

terms.description: Words VoiceFlow listens for. Hints only: they bias recognition and tidy-up, they never rewrite text.

corrections.description: Spellings VoiceFlow always fixes: whole word, ignoring case, applied once to the final text, never chained.

styles.description: Tidy-up styles: a prompt and, optionally, a model.

apps.description: Per-app rules. id: the app (a lower-case Windows exe name, macOS bundle id or Android package name; app ids are native to each platform, with no aliases). style: the style a dictation into that app starts with (a style id or raw). expression: the level it starts with, 0-4. terms: reserved. Each entry needs a unique id; references to word ids and a style id are checked.

expression.description: The expression level dictations into this app start with, over the style's own.

id.description: Stable id: never reuse one for something else. Unique per kind (words, corrections, styles) within a file. The same id in a higher layer replaces the entry.

apps.description: ["*"] for every app, or lower-case app ids: a Windows exe name ("telegram.exe") or a macOS bundle id.

heardAs.description: Forms speech-to-text produces for it. Hints only.

gloss.description: A few words of meaning, for tidy-up ("the household's assistant bot").

priority.description: Higher is more likely to fit in the prompt budget.

from.description: Heard forms, matched as whole words, ignoring case and runs of spaces.

model.description: The model for this style when no per-provider model applies.

models.description: (v2) A model per tidy-up provider. A device uses the one for the provider it is set to, else model, else defaults.cleanupModel.

expression.description: The style's default expression level: 0 Reserved, 1 Subtle, 2 Natural, 3 Lively, 4 Expressive. A level chosen for one dictation, or an app rule's level, comes first.

expressionOverride.description: (v2) Text added after the expression guidance for this style, taking precedence over it (Android's per-style expression override).

icon.description: (v2) A short icon for pickers: an emoji or a few characters, one line.

kind.description: (v2) Which shared expression guidance the style follows: casual, business, family, partner, a fun_* kind (fun_haiku, fun_pirate, fun_shakespeare, fun_noir, fun_wizard) or custom. A fun_* kind a client does not know counts as custom. Absent: the client works it out from the id and label, as in version 1.

guidance.description: (v2) The style's voice in a sentence or two. Shown as its description; a client may also place it where its own prompt shape has room for style guidance (Android's relationship styles). It never replaces prompt.

hidden.description: (v2) true: not offered in pickers or on the bar. It still works where a default or an app rule names it.

defaults.description: Each field is taken from the highest layer that sets it. A field no layer sets is left to the device.

cleanupModel.description: Model for styles that name none.

cleanupStyle.description: A style id, or "raw" for no tidy-up.

pinnedStyles.description: (v2) The styles pinned to the bar, in order: one list, taken whole from the highest layer that sets it (edits last). Ids that name no style are left out and reported.

privacy.description: Added to the built-in privacy lists (never removes a built-in block).

blockApps.description: App ids VoiceFlow never records in or pastes into.

titleDenyRe.description: Window-title patterns (case-insensitive, Rust regex syntax, matched on the device only) that mark a page as sensitive: audio allowed, no context.
